theme.description: A precise, command-center feel tailored for Real Estate professionals (Residential/Commercial). Prioritizes data legibility and operational clarity over decorative elements.

rules.anti_pattern: DO NOT use Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans. Never center-align paragraphs.

layout_spacing.strategy: Dense Data Layout & The Control Room Grid
layout_spacing.grid_bento: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4 sm:gap-6
layout_spacing.pipeline_column: w-80 flex-shrink-0 flex flex-col gap-3 bg-slate-50 p-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200
layout_spacing.rules: Containers with borders must have internal padding (p-4 or p-6). Avoid full-screen gradients. Use pure HTML/Tailwind for structural layout and Shadcn for interactive logic.

buttons.primary: bg-slate-900 text-white hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-md px-4 py-2 font-medium transition-colors focus:ring-2 focus:ring-slate-900 focus:ring-offset-2
buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-slate-200 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50 hover:text-slate-900 rounded-md px-4 py-2 font-medium transition-colors
buttons.ai_action: bg-amber-100 text-amber-900 border border-amber-200 hover:bg-amber-200 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md text-sm font-medium transition-colors flex items-center gap-2

forms.input: bg-white border border-slate-300 rounded-md px-3 py-2 text-sm text-slate-900 placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:border-blue-500
forms.label: text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 mb-1.5 block

tables.header: bg-slate-50 border-y border-slate-200 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-500 uppercase tracking-wider py-3 px-4

icons.usage: Use crisp, consistent stroke widths. For AI features, use the Sparkles icon.

motion_and_interactions.hover: All interactive elements MUST have explicit hover states (e.g., hover:bg-slate-50).
motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use specific transition properties (transition-colors duration-200, transition-transform duration-200). DO NOT use 'transition-all'.
motion_and_interactions.drag_drop: Pipeline cards should scale slightly (scale-105) and gain a larger shadow (shadow-lg) while dragging.
motion_and_interactions.dialogs: Fade-in with slight upward translate for modals (animate-in fade-in zoom-in-95).

accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute. Use kebab-case, role-based naming (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button', data-testid='pipeline-deal-card', data-testid='sidebar-nav-link').
accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast meets APCA/WCAG standards. No gray-on-gray text for critical data.
accessibility.focus: All focusable elements must have visible focus rings (focus:ring-2).

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the design guidelines. Start with Mobile-first responsive grids.
Setup Lucide-react for icons, use it for sidebar, pipeline items, and AI sparkle indicators.
For the Deal Pipeline: use 'react-beautiful-dnd' or '@hello-pangea/dnd' to create the drag-and-drop kanban board.
Shadcn customized rule: override component default border radiuses from standard to 'rounded-lg' or 'rounded-md' for a slightly softer but professional look.
Add 'data-testid' to every actionable button, navigation link, form input, deal card, and dialog trigger. This is critical for automated testing.
The dashboard must display the separated pipelines clearly via tabs or dropdowns: 'Residential Lease', 'Commercial Sale', 'Commercial Lease'.
Integrate a command palette / search for quick contact/property lookup.
Use Recharts or Tremor for the analytics dashboard widgets.
Provide empty states with clear CTAs (e.g., 'No deals in this stage. Add Deal').
Do not use generic Inter font. Update tailwind.config.js to use Cabinet Grotesk (sans) and IBM Plex Sans.
